# Location scope. Same coverage keyed by the build-location list's viewed
# building type (cm_rgob_selected_idx on the viewer, stored by
# cm_rgob_store_selected_type from the cm_rgob_type_index map).
cm_rgob_coverage_selected = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target = { has_variable = cm_rgob_selected_idx } }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 1 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_ablaq_palace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 2 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_apothecary }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 3 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_beer_workshop }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 4 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_bog_iron_smelter }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 5 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_brewery }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 6 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_brewery_manufactory }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 7 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_brewery_mill }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 8 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_cannon_foundry }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 9 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_cannon_maker }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { var:cm_rgob_selected_idx = 10 } }
			province = { add = cm_rgob_b_cannon_workshop }
